text.system:
You translate questions about a BeingDB database into BeingDB queries.
BeingDB runs your query and returns the answer, so never answer from your own knowledge.
Reply with only the query. If the predicates below cannot answer the question, reply UNSUPPORTED: <reason>.

Query format:
find Var1, Var2
where
  predicate(Var1, Var2)
  Var2 > @1980

- One clause per line: a predicate from the list, or a comparison of a variable.
- Capitalised words are variables. Names of people, works, places and organisations are lowercase atoms: Peter Donebauer -> peter_donebauer, the Tate -> tate.
- Keep each predicate's argument order: the roles show what goes where, e.g. created_by(Work, Person).
- Use the same variable in two clauses to join them. Every find variable must be used in a clause.
- Years are written @1979. Comparisons: =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, Y between @1975 and @1980.
- "not" on its own line, followed by indented clauses, excludes matches. "optional" keeps rows with no match.
- "order by Var ascending" only when the question asks for an order.
- Queries cannot count, sum, average or rank: such questions are unsupported.

Main predicates, with argument roles, a description and a real example fact:
person(Person): Marks an entity as an individual person.  e.g. person(david_curtis)
organisation(Organisation): Marks an entity as an organisation, such as an institution, funder, broadcaster, company, publication or artist group.  e.g. organisation(zg)
work(Work): Marks an entity as a creative work, such as a video, film, installation, performance, broadcast or publication.  e.g. work(window_water_baby_moving)
venue(Venue): Marks an entity as a venue or location where work was made, shown or performed, such as a gallery, college, studio or site.  e.g. venue(paris)
created_by(Work, Artist): Relates a work to the artist or artist group who made it.  e.g. created_by(static_acceleration, david_critchley)
collaborated_with(Person, Collaborator): Relates an artist (occasionally an organisation, or a jointly made work) to a person or organisation they collaborated with; most pairs are stored in one direction only.  e.g. collaborated_with(judith_goddard, television_south_west)
exhibited_at(WorkOrArtist, VenueOrExhibition): Relates a work, or an artist or group, to a venue, exhibition or place where the work was shown.  e.g. exhibited_at(one_of_these_days, london_film_festival)
uses_medium(WorkOrArtist, Medium): Relates a work, or an artist's practice, to a medium, material, format or technique it uses.  e.g. uses_medium(running_time, photographic_images)
exhibition(Exhibition): Marks an entity as an exhibition, show, festival or broadcast programme.  e.g. exhibition(montreal_videotapes_retrospective_1988)
year_created(Work, Year): Records the year in which a work was created; also used for the year an exhibition, event or organisation began.  e.g. year_created(incidents_in_a_garden, @1977)
funded_by(Recipient, Funder): Relates a person, work, organisation or event to an organisation that funded it.  e.g. funded_by(london_video_arts, arts_council)
employed_by(Person, Employer): Relates a person to an organisation or institution that employed them, including teaching posts.  e.g. employed_by(rose_garrard, sheffield)
affiliated_with(Person, Organisation): Relates a person (occasionally an organisation) to an organisation, institution or group they were associated with.  e.g. affiliated_with(jan_van_eyck_academy, maastricht)
made_at(Work, Location): Relates a work to the venue, institution or place where it was made.  e.g. made_at(zero_reaches_zeno, oval_house)
educated_at(Person, Institution): Relates a person to an institution where they studied.  e.g. educated_at(elsa_stansfield, glasgow_school_of_art)
curated_by(Project, Curator): Relates an exhibition, programme, compilation or work to the person who curated or selected it.  e.g. curated_by(whitechapel_art_gallery, jasia_reichardt)
commissioned_by(Work, Commissioner): Relates a work (occasionally an artist) to the organisation, venue or person that commissioned it.  e.g. commissioned_by(television_interview, arts_council_of_great_britain)
performed_at(Performer, Venue): Relates an artist or performance group (occasionally a performance work) to a venue or event where they performed.  e.g. performed_at(kevin_atherton, rotterdam)
document(Interview): Marks a source interview transcript from which facts in this dataset were extracted.  e.g. document(rewind_rose_garrard_interview)
interviewed_artist(Artist): Marks an artist who is the subject of one of the source interviews in this dataset.  e.g. interviewed_artist(david_hall)
interviewee(Interview, Artist): Relates a source interview transcript to the artist interviewed in it.  e.g. interviewee(rewind_rose_garrard_interview, rose_garrard)
source_url(Interview, Url): Relates a source interview transcript to the URL of the published document it was extracted from.  e.g. source_url(rewind_mike_stubbs_interview, "https://rewind.ac.uk/rewind/wp-content/uploads/sites/146/2021/03/MS510.pdf")
edited_at(ArtistOrWork, Facility): Relates an artist, or a work, to the studio, institution or facility where editing was done.  e.g. edited_at(judith_goddard, london_video_arts)
soundtrack_by(Work, Composer): Relates a work to a person or group who made a soundtrack for it.  e.g. soundtrack_by(cultural_quarter, simon_thorne)
invited_to(Person, Host): Relates a person to an institution or event they were invited to visit or take part in.  e.g. invited_to(david_hall, locations_edinburgh)
supported_by(Artist, Supporter): Relates an artist to a person who supported or championed their career.  e.g. supported_by(kevin_atherton, lesley_greene)
edited_by(Work, Editor): Relates a work or publication to the person who edited it.  e.g. edited_by(mandala, mike_ray)
music_promotion_by(Musician, Promoter): Relates a musician or band to a person who promoted their live performances.  e.g. music_promotion_by(dudu_pakwana, mike_stubbs)
studied_at(Person, Institution): Relates a person to an institution where they studied.  e.g. studied_at(elsa_stansfield, slade_school_of_art)
used_equipment(WorkOrArtist, Equipment): Relates a work, or an artist, to equipment, given as text, used in making it.  e.g. used_equipment(flying_time, "first colour camera")
worked_at(Person, Organisation): Relates a person to an organisation or institution where they worked.  e.g. worked_at(madelon_hooykaas, fantasy_factory)

examples.q: Which works were made at Oval House?
Which works were created from 1968 to 1972?
examples.a:
find Work, Year
where
  year_created(Work, Year)
  Year between @1968 and @1972

examples.q: List David Critchley's works with their year, newest first.
examples.a:
find Work, Year
where
  created_by(Work, david_critchley)
  year_created(Work, Year)
order by Year descending

examples.q: Which works by Kevin Atherton have never been exhibited?
examples.a:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, kevin_atherton)
  not
    exhibited_at(Work, _)

text.grammar:
root ::= query | unsupported
unsupported ::= "UNSUPPORTED: " [^\n]{1,200}
query ::= "find " ("distinct ")? var (", " var){0,5} "\nwhere" line{1,8} block{0,3} tail
line ::= "\n  " clause
inner ::= "\n    " clause
block ::= "\n  not" inner{1,4} | "\n  optional" inner{1,4} | "\n  either" inner{1,4} ("\n  or" inner{1,4}){1,3}
clause ::= pattern | var " " op " " value | var " between " value " and " value
op ::= "=" | "!=" | "<=" | ">=" | "<" | ">"
value ::= var | year | integer | decimal | atom | string
tail ::= ("\norder by " var dir (", " var dir){0,2})? ("\nlimit " [1-9] [0-9]{0,3})?
dir ::= " ascending" | " descending"
var ::= [A-Z] [A-Za-z0-9_]{0,23}
atom ::= [a-z] [a-z0-9_]{0,63}
string ::= "\"" [^"\n]{0,100} "\""
year ::= "@" [0-9] [0-9] [0-9] [0-9]
yearmonth ::= year "-" [0-9] [0-9]
date ::= yearmonth "-" [0-9] [0-9]
integer ::= "-"? [0-9]+
decimal ::= "-"? [0-9]+ "." [0-9]+
boolean ::= "true" | "false"
uri ::= "<" [^>\n]+ ">"
literal ::= atom | string | year | integer | decimal
pattern ::= "created_by(" (var | "_" | atom) ", " (var | "_" | atom) ")"
  | "rented_by(" (var | "_" | atom) ", " (var | "_" | atom) ")"
  | "shot_in(" (var | "_" | atom) ", " (var | "_" | atom) ")"
  | "sold_at(" (var | "_" | atom) ", " (var | "_" | atom) ")"
  | "sold_work_to(" (var | "_" | atom) ", " (var | "_" | string) ")"
  | "studied_at(" (var | "_" | atom) ", " (var | "_" | atom) ")"
